request.style: English, female jazz vocal, smooth and intimate, piano, double bass, upright bass, brushed drums, mood of serene reassurance, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The world and all that fills it is mine
I do not need your flesh or wine
Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink
The blood of goats that you think

[Chorus]
Offer God a sacrifice of praise
And fulfill your vows in grace
Then call on me in the day of trouble
I will deliver you
And you will honor me

[Verse]
But to the wicked God says clearly
What right have you to speak
To recite my statutes on your lips
While you do not keep

[Chorus]
Offer God a sacrifice of praise
And fulfill your vows in grace
Then call on me in the day of trouble
I will deliver you
And you will honor me

[Bridge]
You hate discipline and cast my words behind
You approve the thief and join the sin

[Chorus]
Offer God a sacrifice of praise
And fulfill your vows in grace
Then call on me in the day of trouble
I will deliver you
And you will honor me

[Outro]
Call on me in the day of trouble
I will deliver you
